sources.entry: LibreTime - Broadcast streaming radio on the web (fork of Airtime). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/PHP

summary.one_liner: Airtime is an open source application for remote, collaborative automation and live streaming of a broadcast radio station.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a web-based interface where authorized staff can add programme material, create playlists and smart blocks, and stream live. It includes a scheduler that plays shows at a specified date and time, and playlists, smart blocks and remote stream URLs can be reused multiple times. Playback is handled by the Liquidsoap streaming language, which the README describes as reliable and precise across multiple outputs. The installer sets up components such as Icecast 2 and Apache, and a browser-based setup wizard finishes configuration and runs a checklist to verify the installation. The code is extensible under AGPLv3.
use_cases: automate a radio station's playlist and schedule
schedule shows for playback at set times
how_to_run: Open a web browser and complete the interactive setup
notable: Scheduler for timed playback of shows, playlists and smart blocks
Uses Liquidsoap for playout to multiple outputs
Non-interactive installer with flags for Icecast, Apache and Postgres setup
AGPLv3 licensed and open to modification
caveats: Installer requires sudo and sets up system services such as Icecast 2 and Apache
README mentions a Bash requirement; non-Bash terminals need an extra step
README points to the Freenode IRC channel, which may be outdated
